_comment: Onboarding rev O4: [Mage] via PISCES, not the retired Dusty Scroll. The honest new-game flow (classless start + live proximity ambush): meet Relc -> spar -> sleep (Warrior L1) -> cross the floodplains ambush FIGHTING it (warrior kit + Relc ally) -> Liscor gate -> street -> Pisces teaches magic (banks learned_magic_from_pisces) -> back to the inn -> sleep ([Mage] gained, grants-listing toast) -> goblin_encounter_2 with the mage kit fielded. Long but it is the real cold-start path (the scroll no longer grants the mage class). Cell routes reuse combat_walkthrough/level_up_loop/inventory_loop idioms verbatim where possible; the gate-crossing + Pisces legs are O4-derived (see task-o4-report.md).

Return to the inn to sleep. Relc at (12,13); player at (12,12). Up to y6, left to the inn-door cell (7,6), up+interact -> floodplains_inn_door -> inn (14,3).
Inn (14,3) -> bed (2,7): left 12 to (2,3), down to (2,6), down blocks on the bed and faces it, interact -> sleep.

(31,24) -> inn, routing around the SE wall/chieftains_raid (col 31 is walled/occupied above y8) and the central fishing-pond (walls.segments x7-13, y17-21): up to (31,8), jog left to (30,8), up to (30,6), then west along the clear y6 lane to (7,6). Ambush dormant, so crossing its zone cells never re-triggers.
== PHASE E: field the mage kit in a real fight ==. Out to floodplains, east+south to goblin_encounter_2 (28,18) -- interact-only, well north of the ambush zone.
goblin_parley hub option 0 'Draw steel.' -> start_combat.
